name: google-sheets-mcp
description: Read and edit Google Sheets in place: update cells, append rows, insert/delete rows and columns, write formulas, format, and find & replace.

oauth_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
oauth_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 Desktop client ID from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > Credentials). Leave empty if using a service account key file.

oauth_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
oauth_client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 Desktop client secret paired with the client ID above.

service_account_key_file.title: Service Account Key File (alternative)
service_account_key_file.description: Path to a service-account JSON key. Only needed if not using OAuth; share target sheets with the service account's email.
